# Sourdough pizza dough

Uses 100 g of active starter for four pizzas. Mix 500 g bread flour, 325 g water, 12 g salt and the starter. Bulk ferment for four hours, then cold proof the dough balls in the fridge for 24 to 48 hours.

Bake on a preheated steel at the oven's highest temperature for seven minutes. A long cold proof gives a blistered crust.
